text:
NEEDS_FIX: YES
<assessment>The main café form and front/side openings are recognizable, but the attached low wing is too small in the current oblique views, and the source’s broad pale stone apron is missing.</assessment>
<issue priority="1" view="oblique">problem: The source shows a substantial lower white annex extending behind and to the right, with a clearly visible low roof. The current annex barely projects beyond the main volume. action: Extend the existing lower wing and its roof to match the source’s visible projection, keeping it below the main volume.</issue>
<issue priority="2" view="oblique">problem: The source has a broad light stone apron around the café, distinct from the localized wood deck. The current base reads mostly as one continuous brown deck with only a thin pale edge. action: Widen the pale stone perimeter apron and limit the brown decking to the entry and seating areas.</issue>
<keep>Front entrance remains left of the broad display window, as in the source.</keep>
<keep>The upper volume’s vertical wood cladding and dark sloped roof preserve the source’s main material and roof character.</keep>
<keep>The side serving window projects outward beneath its own canopy, matching the source arrangement.</keep>
